outcome: Took up the guild's standing charge to hand something to any poor Skyrim citizen in need.
citation: s10 obj "Help The Poor People Of Skyrim": "Anyone I see who needs my help, I should now be able to give them something. In return, it is possible I might get a little luck, courtesy of the Gray Fox."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; s10 is the only evidence-bearing stage and carries the giving act (terminal 20 has no text).

outcome: Leaned on Maven Black-Briar to keep her in line and collected a regular cut from her.
citation: s10: "Make sure Maven and everyone else knows who's boss! Go back to visit Maven regularly to check up on her and get your cut."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; coercive shakedown of a former patron read as exploit_cheat (vocabulary has no intimidation tag).

outcome: Burgled Maven Black-Briar's manor and recovered the bag of gems she had taken from Riften's poor.
citation: s40 obj "Return the Bag of Gems to Bolli": "I have recovered the stolen gems from Maven's manor. I should take this to Bolli right away!"
branch_note: Defined mod quest; burglary aimed at the corrupt patron rather than a victim.

outcome: Returned the recovered gems to Bolli and relieved someone in desperate need.
citation: s50: "I have assisted someone who desperately needed help. I should continue on my other adventures until I get another request for aid."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; the giving half of the Bolli branch.

outcome: Lifted the confidential papers back out of the Jarl of Windhelm's keeping for Suvaris Atheron.
citation: s80 obj "Return The Stolen Papers To Suvaris Atheron": "I have found the confidential papers. I should return them to Suvaris, who is most likely somewhere in the Gray Quarter."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; recovery theft against the Jarl on a Gray Quarter petitioner's behalf.

outcome: Handed the stolen papers back to their rightful owner in the Gray Quarter.
citation: s90: "I have returned the item to its rightful owner. I should wait for another request for help."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; the restitution half of the Suvaris branch.

outcome: Took the withheld cure back from the Silver-Bloods in Markarth.
citation: s110 obj "Give The Cure To Cairine": "I have the cure! I should give it to Cairine!"
branch_note: Defined mod quest; s110 and s120 carry identical text for the same acquisition - both rowed since the mod can land on either.

outcome: Took the withheld cure back from the Silver-Bloods in Markarth.
citation: s120 obj "Give The Cure To Cairine": "I have the cure! I should give it to Cairine!"
branch_note: Defined mod quest; duplicate of s110 with identical text - rowed separately because either stage can fire.

outcome: Gave Cairine the cure and saved her life and the lives of others in the Warrens.
citation: s130: "I have given Cairine the cure to her illness. It will take awhile for her to heal, but at least she will live now, as will others."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; the healing half of the Markarth branch.

outcome: Recovered the necklace taken from Erdi's household in Solitude.
citation: s150 obj "Give The Necklace To Erdi": "I have the item. I should return it."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; acquisition half of the Solitude branch.

outcome: Returned the necklace to Erdi its rightful owner.
citation: s160 obj "Wait For Another Request For Help": "I have returned the item."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; restitution half of the Solitude branch.

outcome: Broke into Black-Briar Lodge and came away with proof of Maven's betrayal of the Empire.
citation: s180 obj "Speak To Delvin": "I now have evidence of Maven's betrayal of the empire."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; burglary of the Black-Briar lodge for leverage.

outcome: Used Maven's treason to cut the Guild free of her and pledged its take to Skyrim's poorest.
citation: s220 [COMPLETE]: "I have freed the Thieves Guild from Maven's corrupting influence, and the Guild is now going to be helping the poorest people regularly with the money we steal."
branch_note: Defined mod quest; terminal stage of the good-thief line.

outcome: Cut and hauled apiary logs for Aringoth to rebuild rather than burning his hives.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY - s10 obj "Gather apiary materials for Aringoth (<Global=TCBMTG02LogCount>/<Global=TCBMTG02LogReq> sawn logs)"; no journal text on any stage, tier B.
branch_note: Defined mod quest; the non-arson alternative to TG02's beehive burning. Terminal s200 has no text so the labour act is rowed at s10.

outcome: Walked away from Brynjolf's organisation once his Riften scheme was over rather than take up with it.
citation: s210 [COMPLETE]: "Brynjolf's scheme in Riften has ended and the promise of more coin has been made, but I'm washing my hands of his organisation, whatever it is."
branch_note: Override; this stage is the mod's addition - vanilla ends only at s200, whose text is carried unchanged and is therefore skipped, as are the vanilla Madesi's-ring stages s10/s20. NEEDS-TAG: refuse_criminal_faction (declined to join a criminal organisation)

outcome: Warned Sabjorn to call off the tasting instead of letting the framing run its course.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY - s31 obj "(Optional) Warn Sabjorn to cancel the tasting"; objective only, no journal text, tier B.
branch_note: Override; this stage is the mod's addition - vanilla has no warn-the-mark objective. Opens the spare-Sabjorn branch.

outcome: Spared Sabjorn from ruin and was given the financing information willingly.
citation: s95: "Now that I've saved Sabjorn from essential ruin, he's given me what I need to find any information explaining how he was able to fund this costly operation."
branch_note: Override; this stage is the mod's addition - the non-evil terminal opposite vanilla s80 (Sabjorn poisoned out and jailed), whose text is carried unchanged and is therefore skipped.
